l-m-m3-b03-01.title: Ukuba b i-even, ingaba sisikwere esigqibeleleyo?
l-m-m3-b03-01.goal: Hlola ukuba ibango lokuba x²+bx+c sisikwere esigqibeleleyo xa b i-even liyinyani rhoqo, uze ufumane uchaze imeko apho lingeyonyani (umzekelo ochasayo).
l-m-m3-b03-01.material: Ibango: Kwi-x²+bx+c, ukuba b i-even, ibinzana lihlala lisisikwere esigqibeleleyo. Fumana ibinzana elibonisa ukuba eli bango alichanekanga.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s1.explain: x²+4x+3=(x+1)(x+3) ayiyiyo imveliso yamabinzana amabini omgca afanayo. Nangona b i-even, asisosikwere esigqibeleleyo.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s2.model.0: x²+4x+3 yi-(x+1)(x+3), enezibalo ezimbini ezahlukileyo, ngoko asisosikwere esigqibeleleyo, kwaye ngumzekelo ochasayo nangona b=4 i-even.
l-m-m3-b03-01.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba sisikwere esigqibeleleyo, c=(b÷2)² iyafuneka, kodwa 3 ayiyiyo i-(4÷2)²=4, ngoko ngumzekelo ochasayo.

l-m-m3-b05-23.title: Ukuba tan A×tan B=1, ngaba A=B?
l-m-m3-b05-23.goal: Gqiba ukuba ingxelo "ukuba tan A×tan B=1, ngoko A no-B yi-engile enye" yinyani ngamaxesha onke, uze ufumane uchaze imeko apho ingeyiyo (umzekelo ochasayo).
l-m-m3-b05-23.material: tan 30°=1/√3, tan 45°=1, tan 60°=√3. Isibakala: ukuba tan A×tan B=1, ngoko A no-B yi-engile enye. Fumana u-A no-B ababonisa ukuba esi sibakala siyaphosakala.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.r.b: Imveliso ngu-3, ngoko ayanelisi imeko ethi tan A×tan B=1.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.r.c: Imveliso ngu-1/3, ngoko ayanelisi imeko ethi tan A×tan B=1.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.r.d: Imveliso ngu-1 kwaye A=B, ngoko lo mzekelo uyayilungela ingxelo.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s1.explain: tan 30°×tan 60°=(1/√3)×√3=1, kodwa 30°≠60°. Ii-engile ezimbini ezongeza zibe yi-90° nazo zinika imveliso engu-1.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s2.model.0: (1/√3)×√3=1, ngoko imeko iyanelisa, kodwa A=30° no-B=60° zi-engile ezahlukeneyo, ngoko lo ngumzekelo ochasayo.
l-m-m3-b05-23.s.s2.model.1: tan 30° kunye ne-tan 60° zii-reciprocal omnye komnye, ngoko imveliso yazo ngu-1, kodwa ii-engile ezimbini zahlukile, ngoko isibakala siyaphosakala.

l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s1.explain: Incopho ikwi-x=p, kwaye ukuba a>0, elo chaphaza lilona lincinci. Ngoko p=2 kwaye a>0.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s2.model.0: I-x apho ubuncinane okanye ubuninzi bubakho yikhowudinethi ye-x p yencopho, kwaye bubuncinane ukuba a>0, ngoko p=2 kwaye a>0 ziyafuneka.
l-m-m3-b03-07.s.s2.model.1: Ubungakanani be-q ne-a abunakutshintsha indawo yobuncinane, ngoko iyasebenza ukuba p=2 kwaye a>0, evula ngaphezulu.

l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Amanani amaninzi aphelele anje ngo-k=1, 2, kunye no-3 anokwenzeka.
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.o.c: Imeko yokuba kukho ingcambu enye kuphela (ingcambu ephindiweyo)
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Ngengcambu ephindiweyo, x²−4x+k=(x−2)², ngoko k=4. Ezinye iimeko azinakumisela k njengexabiso elinye.
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: Ngengcambu ephindiweyo, kufuneka ibe yi-(x−2)²=x²−4x+4, ngoko k imiselwa njenge-4. Ezinye iimeko azonelanga kuba k inamaxabiso amaninzi.
l-m-m3-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: Ukuba kukho ingcambu enye kuphela, idisikriminanti 16−4k ingu-0, ngoko k=4. Iimeko ezilungileyo okanye zenani eliphelele zivumela ii-k ezininzi, ngoko azonelanga.

l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.o.c: Ukuba ikoyifishenti ye-x², k−2, ayingo-0 na
l-m-m3-b0s6-03.s.s1.r.d: 3 sele ingeyo-0, kwaye ukuba yiquadratic kumiselwa yikoyifishenti ye-x².

l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s1.r.c: ③ ifaka ngokuchanekileyo isiphumo se-②. Ayiyo impazamo yokuqala.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s1.r.d: 60° kunye ne-60° zidibana zibe yi-120°, hayi i-180°, ngoko akuchanekanga.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s1.explain: Isixa seengile ezimbini ezichasene yi-180°. 3x+2x+20=180, ngoko x=32 kwaye ∠A=96°.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s2.model.0: Iingile ezichasene azilingani; isixa sazo kufuneka sibe yi-180°, kodwa ① zibeke zilingana. 3x+2x+20=180, ngoko x=32.
l-m-m3-b05-34.s.s2.model.1: Iingile ezichasene zequadrilateral esangqeni zidibana zibe yi-180°, ngoko ① iphosisile, kwaye xa kusonjululwe ngokuchanekileyo, ∠A=96°.
